name: retry_steering_repo_provision
description: Re-send a failed or blocked steering repo setup so the job runs again from its first step.

connection.description: The GitHub organization or GitLab group to create steering repos in, when setup stopped with choose_connection. One of get_steering_repo's connectionChoices.

resetConnection.description: Set true to clear the organization's stored steering connection first, so the run lists the GitHub organizations and GitLab groups again. Refused (conflict connection_in_use) once Oxagen has created a steering repo in the stored one.
